cmapss.prompt_header: Classify turbofan engine health using only the following sensor summaries. The summaries use exactly the last 30 observed cycles, including the current observation; std is the population standard deviation and slope is a least-squares linear slope per cycle. Choose exactly one label: Healthy (remaining useful life >80 cycles), Degrading (30<remaining useful life<=80 cycles), or Critical (remaining useful life<=30 cycles). Remaining useful life is not supplied; infer the stage from the sensor values.

methods.split: Official FD001 train/test trajectories; numeric engine IDs are namespaced by raw partition and do not denote the same engines.
methods.window: Exactly 30 consecutive rows [t-29,t]; no observation after t is used for features.
methods.training_windows: Up to five equally spaced observation endpoints per training engine from the first complete 30-row window to its final cycle.
methods.test_selection: One last observed window per official test engine; seed-stratified selection of at most 20 engines per RUL class; no model-output-based selection.
methods.sensor_selection: Training-only sample standard deviation >0.001; asserted to yield the fixed 15 sensors.
methods.label_definition: Healthy RUL>80; Degrading 30<RUL<=80; Critical RUL<=30. Test uses official RUL_FD001 at last observation; train uses failure cycle minus endpoint.
